genres.name: Clever Thriller
genres.instruction: I want to be kept a step behind without being shouted at.

genres.name: Slow Burn
genres.instruction: I like films that take their time and trust me to wait.

mixes.name: Quiet Dread
mixes.instruction: Dread that arrives on foot, in daylight. Nothing gory, and nothing with torture in it — I will turn it off.
